headline: A law renaming the Simi Valley, California post office at 2551 Galena Avenue as the "Neil Havens Post Office."
what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service facility in Simi Valley, California, a new name in honor of Neil Havens. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change how mail is delivered or what services the post office offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 16, 2014.
